source.visibility: private; source bytes must stay outside public Git

profiles.scope: original evaluation choice component; complete game adapter unfinished
explicit original no-training sampled choice component; not the evaluation default

selection.implementation: hash-verified original Java methods extracted to private build files
selection.normalization: original float32 log, maximum subtraction and softmax of candidate probabilities
selection.rng: one java.util.Random per owned game, seeded directly from the protocol agent seed
selection.fair_variant: deterministic game seeding; invalid input or returned choices refuse rather than falling back

mulligan.fair_variant: original own-hand features and remaining-library multiset; library sorted by card name; no hidden order
mulligan.wiring: private original feature port and paired-network pregame component; guarded native execution unfinished

modes.head: action
modes.feature_overwrite: feature 0 = original float32 ordinal / candidate count
modes.mode_cost_feature: feature 13 = 1.0 when Mode.getCost() is non-null, else 0.0
modes.single_or_exhausted: direct original return; no model or RNG use
modes.mana_source_staging_flag: mode_mana_callback: true; requires mode_callback and dialog_callback
modes.wiring: permitted callback replay, source-bound frame, paired policy and owned original chooser; optional original filtered mana rules preserve mode costs and legality
modes.limitations: native execution including modes with costs pending; original automatic mana production and complete games unfinished

dialogs.binary_ids: original CHOOSE_USE_YES and CHOOSE_USE_NO Java token IDs
dialogs.x_bound: original cap at 20, tightened by filtered mana, base cost, X instances and conditional mana applicability
dialogs.head: action
dialogs.forced_returns: original mana feasibility gates and single X value; no model or RNG use
dialogs.wiring: permitted actual callback replay, original private rules, paired model and owned original chooser
dialogs.limitations: native execution pending; automatic mana production, other numeric callbacks and complete games unfinished

mana_payment.engine_planning_queues: empty, as in the original RL action path
mana_payment.producer_order: original usable-producer filtering, source and tap-target exclusions, stable penalty ordering during payment
mana_payment.context: original nested unpaid-mana thread context; separate activation reservations per actual or copied player
mana_payment.callbacks: original color preference and tap-target heuristics; original ordinary engine delegation preserves ordered pending costs
mana_payment.wiring: optional source-bound replay hooks in both mode and binary/X pipes; separate payment variants and strict paired-policy consumers
mana_payment.limitations: private rules, activation/payment lifecycle and engine delegation parity require guarded native qualification; full games unfinished

targets.source_staging_flag: target_callback: true; requires mana_payment_callback and the original prefix rules
targets.original_order: actual possible-target order, filtered by original legality and earlier picks; STOP first when the original gate permits
targets.direct_returns: one option and same-name non-null targets bypass inference and chooser RNG, including when STOP is offered
targets.feature_shapes: 256 by 128 state; 64 by 48 candidates; original IDs and first 64 slots
targets.prefix_rules: original mode legality, binary feasibility, X ranges and automatic mana payment
targets.completion_rules: original minimum and Crew/Saddle completion retained in the private loop; native cost adapters remain unfinished
targets.limitations: native private target execution, prefix/copy semantics and chooser application pending; cost, provided-card, divided-target and opponent-sourced callbacks, exact decks and complete games unfinished

general_targets.source_staging_flag: Uses the existing target_callback flag and eight unchanged private stage bodies
general_targets.original_policy: Same original general target loop and target head; generic TargetCard callbacks are supported when no card set is provided
general_targets.wire_binding: Preserves original action echo, complete source/reference/range binding and original possible-target order; normalization never changes public observations
general_targets.prefix_rules: Original mode, binary, X, payment and earlier general target choices
general_targets.limitations: Native execution, generic card/cost callbacks and full games unqualified; provided-card, divided-target, opponent-source and incompatible public/original ranges remain unfinished

card_sets.source_staging_flag: card_set_callback: true; requires target_callback and the original prefix rules
card_sets.original_policy: chooseTarget(Outcome, Cards, TargetCard, Ability, Game); original provided-card filtering and sequential selection
card_sets.original_groups: Name groups only for TargetCardInLibrary and TargetCardInHand; other TargetCard types retain separate copies; first available representative and first 64 groups
card_sets.direct_returns: One original group bypasses model and chooser RNG; a multi-copy group still chooses a physical copy
card_sets.copy_variant: Owned Python MT19937 seeded from SHA-256 of the card-copy domain and canonical game_start; singleton copies direct; original Java neural chooser stream unchanged
card_sets.wire_binding: Every physical copy, STOP, source and range bound to the original public action; recorded earlier picks consume neither model nor copy RNG
card_sets.limitations: Private native execution and full games unqualified; inherited choose(Cards), divided targets, opponent callbacks and incompatible public/original ranges remain unfinished

parent_cards.source_staging_flag: parent_card_callback: true; requires card_set_callback and all original prefix rules
parent_cards.original_policy: Inherited choose(Outcome, Cards, TargetCard, Ability, Game) through original ComputerPlayer7/6 with empty planning queues
parent_cards.ordering: Original good/bad target lists, score and name ordering, UUID ties and target.add; no public-ID re-ranking or current-engine scorer substitution
parent_cards.completion_variant: Original implicit completion is bound to an offered legal STOP; unsupported or incomplete minima refuse
parent_cards.owner_streams: No model, neural chooser or physical-copy RNG; recorded parent prefix must equal the original determined choice
parent_cards.prefix_rules: Original neural provided-card, general-target, mode, binary, X and payment rules
parent_cards.limitations: Private native execution, planning queues, other callbacks, exact decks and full games remain unqualified; incompatible ranges, divided targets and opponent callbacks refuse
